categories.title: Terminal Maps
tips: Domestic and international departures share the Main Terminal.
Allow extra time to walk between Pier A and Pier C.
Free Wi-Fi is available throughout the terminal.
Follow purple wayfinding signs to Canada Line and parking.

categories.title: Custom and Immigration
tips: Have passport and customs declaration ready before landing.
Use Primary Inspection Kiosks when available.
Declare food, plants, and currency over CAD $10,000.
NEXUS lanes can speed eligible travellers.

categories.title: Shop, Dine and Services
tips: Local favourites and national chains are airside after security.
Duty-free is available for international departures.
Currency exchange and ATMs are near arrivals and departures.
Family washrooms and nursing rooms are clearly signed.

categories.title: Parking
tips: Parkade connects directly to the terminal via covered walkways.
Economy lots offer shuttle service for longer stays.
Canada Line SkyTrain is often faster than driving downtown.
Pre-book parking online for better rates during peak season.

booking.notes: Late check-in available until midnight. Concierge has your preference for a harbour-view room.

transportation.name: Airport Shuttle
transportation.detail: Shared van to downtown hotels · ~30–45 min · from CAD $20
transportation.tips: Book at the ground transportation desk or via the hotel concierge.

transportation.name: Canada Line SkyTrain
transportation.detail: YVR → Waterfront Station · ~25 min · Compass Card / contactless
transportation.tips: Trains run frequently; follow signs marked Canada Line from arrivals.

transportation.name: Rideshare
transportation.detail: Uber / Lyft pickup zone · ~20–35 min depending on traffic
transportation.tips: Use the designated rideshare pickup area outside International Arrivals.
